target.title: test(cron): add restart catch-up coverage for recurring command jobs
target.body: What Problem This Solves Issue #104412 reports that recurring cron jobs with payload.kind="command" are silently skipped across gateway stop/start windows. While investigating the issue, I noticed the restart catch-up test suite only covered systemEvent jobs, leaving both command job recovery paths untested. Why This Change Was Made Without test coverage for command jobs in startup catch-up, there was no way to confirm the two recovery scenarios worked correctly: A job added but never run (no lastRunAtMs) whose nextRunAtMs falls inside a stop window A job whose nextRunAtMs was already advanced past a missed slot, requiring the allowCronMissedRunByLastRun fallback path Both scenarios needed coverage regardless of whether a production bug exists on current main. User Impact No behavior change. Tests only. Proves the restart catch-up machinery correctly handles recurring command jobs in both recovery paths on current main, closing the gap identified during investigation. Evidence Both new tests pass on current main (17/17 total in the suite):
